# Tranquil Haven Coaching

> Private, psychologically-informed online coaching for women seeking
> emotional clarity, calmer relationships, and thoughtful personal growth.
> Quiet, reflective, ICF-aligned. Coaching only — not therapy.

## About the practice
- [About](https://tranquilhaven.coach/about): Who Tranquil Haven serves and the coaching philosophy ("Less noise. More you.").
- [Credentials](https://tranquilhaven.coach/credentials): ICF Member, ICF-accredited Level 2 training, psychology-informed background.
- [FAQ](https://tranquilhaven.coach/faq): What coaching is and is not, confidentiality, session format, pricing.

## Coaching
- [Coaching & packages](https://tranquilhaven.coach/coaching): Clarity Session $120 (single), Focused Support $460 (4 sessions), Deeper Work $880 (8 sessions), Life Transition $1,200 (12 sessions). 50-minute online (Zoom) sessions. English and Russian.
- [Contact](https://tranquilhaven.coach/contact): Email thavencoach@gmail.com, Instagram @tranquilhavencoaching, Facebook community.

## Inner Compass (reflective writing)
- [Insights](https://tranquilhaven.coach/insights): Short reflections on clarity, relationships, life transitions.
- [Resources](https://tranquilhaven.coach/resources): Gentle self-check-ins and reflection prompts.
- [Reflection Stories](https://tranquilhaven.coach/reflection-stories): First-person narrative pieces about love, presence, and quiet change.

## Optional
- [Testimonials](https://tranquilhaven.coach/testimonials): Words from women who shared this space.
- [Privacy Policy](https://tranquilhaven.coach/privacy): Confidentiality, data handling, ICF Code of Ethics.
